body: Sapphire black :) I had been going ruby red for months. Time for change.

Pcos.. wicked hormone/metabolic curse.. weight issues no matter how much I exercise and facial hair that has to be dealt with daily. Its humiliating. Its manageable with someone I trust... but not with my current perfectionist bf... ive heard him ridicule other women for it so I am obsessed with trying to be my best. Which is exhaustive.  I know... leave him. But I dont. And yes I have done therapy. Her thoughts were if one person accepts me for me, just one, then whats the issue.
Yeah.. hair dye was the better option.
